Package com.neueda.leap.reporting.service

Record Class TradeDataset.Trade

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.reporting.service.TradeDataset.Trade
Record Components:
fillId - fill identifier
orderId - the order it filled
filledAt - execution time
instrumentId - instrument identifier
instrumentSymbol - ticker symbol
instrumentName - company name
assetClass - instrument class
marketCode - listing market
userId - owning user
clientEmail - owner's sign-in email
clientName - owner's first and last name
accountId - trading account identifier
accountNumber - human-readable account number
accountName - account label
accountStatus - account status
traderLevel - NOVICE or ADVANCED
side - BUY or SELL
filledQuantity - shares filled
executionPrice - price per share
Enclosing class:
TradeDataset

One fill in the dataset.
